comment: m68_Gran.ino:138-142 compares the trigger jack against 0xA00 and 0x900 rather than the 0xA000 and 0x9000 used elsewhere in the firmware. Those work out as about -4.88V and -4.93V, so the jack reads high for anything a normal module puts out and never returns low.
